description:
STEP Stibo Developer — Customer MDM Support (Financial Services)

Location: Warsaw, Kraków, Wrocław, Łódź (Poland) / Bucharest, Cluj-Napoca (Romania) /

                               Sofia (Bulgaria) / Prague, Brno (Czech Republic), Portugal, Spain, Cyprus

Work Mode: Fully Remote

Contract: B2B contract or local employment, depending on country

Seniority: Senior Developer (5–7 years)

Rate     : 200 Euros

Contract: B2B contract or local employment, depending on country

Seniority: Senior Developer (5–7 years)

THE ENGAGEMENT

Support and enhance a live STEP MDM platform at a UK financial services

client, working from an Infosys nearshore delivery centre in Central/Eastern

Europe. This is a run-and-iterate role on an existing Customer MDM

deployment — extending, tuning, and supporting it, not building from scratch.

The platform underpins the client's single view of customer data across

multiple product lines, integrated with their broader data fabric.



Requirements

WHAT WE NEED

5–7 years' hands-on Stibo STEP development — configuration, customisation,

integration. Working knowledge of STEP CWB, STEP APIs, business rules in

JavaScript, XML / XSD / XPath / XSLT, and Java. Working understanding of

Customer MDM (CMDM) — match-merge, survivorship, golden record. Experience

with at least one major ETL or integration tool (SAP BODS, Informatica,

ODI, SSIS, or similar). SQL working level (Oracle or SQL Server). English

working proficiency (B2 minimum) — UK client communication is daily.

 

NICE TO HAVE

Financial services delivery exposure. Stibo certification. Exposure to Erwin

Data Intelligence, Erwin Data Modeler, SAP BusinessObjects, Tableau, or

OneTrust. BAU support experience on a live MDM platform (not just

implementation projects). Prior UK or Western European client experience.

 

WORK AUTHORISATION

EU / EEA nationals. Polish, Romanian, Bulgarian, Czech nationals — direct.

Ukrainian CUKR holders already in Poland — direct.

·       Applicants must have valid work authorization in their country of application. No sponsorship available.
